LEVEL_11.description: Maps are wider and longer: width +1; Act 1 +1 row, Act 2 +1 row, Act 3 +2 rows.
LEVEL_11.title: Wide Tower, Long Road
LEVEL_12.description: Act 1 contains [blue]2[/blue] optional [gold]Firemarked Elites[/gold]; Acts 2 and 3 contain [blue]3[/blue]. Their [gold]Firemark Host[/gold] is stronger; defeat them for a [gold]Forge Token[/gold] and better card rewards.
LEVEL_12.title: Firemarked Elite Pack
LEVEL_13.description: Some [gold]Attack[/gold] and [gold]Skill[/gold] rewards have [gold]Fission[/gold]: they cost [blue]1[/blue] less and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] after play.
LEVEL_13.title: Fission Enchantment
LEVEL_14.description: Start with Rootblight I. Ignored Rootblight worsens after combat.
LEVEL_14.title: Rootblight Begins
LEVEL_15.description: Act 2 and Act 3 Boss fights bury 2 Blight Sprouts. They sprout on rounds 3 and 4, and can add Rootblight only if you have none.
LEVEL_15.title: Boss Blight Sprout
LEVEL_16.description: Banner Rooms appear on the map. They are normal combats with visible combat rules.
LEVEL_16.title: Banner Rooms
LEVEL_17.description: Act 2 and Act 3 contain optional Deep Branches with higher risk and higher reward.
LEVEL_17.title: Deep Branches
LEVEL_18.description: Mid and late Act 2 and Act 3 Elites also bury a Blight Sprout. Seen sprouts can add Rootblight if not played.
LEVEL_18.title: Elite Blight Sprout
LEVEL_19.description: Each Boss gains a Royal Seal, and Boss card rewards show one more card.
LEVEL_19.title: Boss Royal Seals
LEVEL_20.description: Act 3 double-Boss information is revealed early. The second Boss's Royal Seal becomes a King Brand.
LEVEL_20.title: Dual King Brands
MODIFIER_GUIDE.description: Map hover previews name the exact [gold]Firemark[/gold], [gold]Banner[/gold], [gold]Royal Seal[/gold], or [gold]King Brand[/gold] before you enter the room.
MODIFIER_GUIDE.title: Map Modifier Preview
FIREMARK_ELITE.description: An optional Elite with a stronger Firemark Host and improved rewards.
FIREMARK_ELITE.title: Firemarked Elite
FIREMARK_MIGHT.description: The [gold]Firemark Host[/gold] starts combat with [gold]Strength[/gold]: [blue]2[/blue] in Act 1, [blue]3[/blue] in Act 2, and [blue]4[/blue] in Act 3.
FIREMARK_MIGHT.title: Firemark: Might
FIREMARK_GIANT.description: The [gold]Firemark Host[/gold] starts combat with [blue]30%[/blue] more max HP.
FIREMARK_GIANT.title: Firemark: Giant
FIREMARK_FORGE_ARMOR.description: The [gold]Firemark Host[/gold] gains [gold]Block[/gold] at the end of its turn: [blue]8[/blue] in Act 1, [blue]13[/blue] in Act 2, and [blue]18[/blue] in Act 3.
FIREMARK_FORGE_ARMOR.title: Firemark: Forge Armor
FIREMARK_CONSTANT_HEAL.description: The [gold]Firemark Host[/gold] heals at the end of its turn: [blue]6[/blue] HP in Act 1, [blue]10[/blue] HP in Act 2, and [blue]14[/blue] HP in Act 3.
FIREMARK_CONSTANT_HEAL.title: Firemark: Constant Heal
BANNER_BOUNTY.description: Kill the marked enemy before the end of round [blue]3[/blue] to gain [blue]15[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] after combat. If it survives, it gains [blue]8[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold].
BANNER_BOUNTY.title: Bounty Banner
BANNER_ROOM.description: Enhanced normal combat with a public banner rule.
BANNER_ROOM.title: Banner Room
BANNER_SHIELD_FORMATION.description: One enemy is the bannerbearer. While it lives, other enemies gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] at the start of each round. When it dies, other enemies gain [blue]8[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
BANNER_SHIELD_FORMATION.title: Shield Formation Banner
BANNER_VANGUARD.description: Enemies start with [blue]2[/blue] temporary [gold]Strength[/gold]. It is removed at the start of round [blue]3[/blue].
DEEP_BRANCH_ENTRY.description: Entrance to an optional Deep Branch. It reconnects later, and a normal route remains available.
DEEP_BRANCH_ENTRY.title: Deep Branch Entrance
DEEP_BRANCH_REWARD.description: A Deep Branch reward node. It pays better because the branch path is riskier.
DEEP_BRANCH_REWARD.title: Deep Branch Reward
DEEP_BRANCH_RISK.description: A Deep Branch risk node. It is optional and reconnects to the main map.
DEEP_BRANCH_RISK.title: Deep Branch Risk
BANNER_VANGUARD.title: Vanguard Banner
BOSS_KING_BRAND.description: The second Boss bears a stronger Brand. Check the combat indicator before committing.
BOSS_KING_BRAND.title: King Brand
BOSS_ROYAL_SEAL.description: This Boss bears a Royal Seal. Check the combat indicator for its rule.
BOSS_ROYAL_SEAL.title: Royal Seal
BOSS_SEAL_HOLY_DAZE.title: Holy Daze
BOSS_SEAL_HOLY_DAZE.summary: The first stun round becomes setup instead of burst.
BOSS_SEAL_HOLY_DAZE.brand: After the stun ends, the Boss gains 2 Strength.
BOSS_SEAL_MARTYR_OATH.title: Martyr Oath
BOSS_SEAL_MARTYR_OATH.summary: Follower deaths strengthen Kin Priest with capped Block and Strength.
BOSS_SEAL_MARTYR_OATH.brand: Up to 3 follower deaths trigger it, each for 14 Block.
BOSS_SEAL_INK_RETURN.title: Ink Return
BOSS_SEAL_INK_RETURN.summary: The first full Slippery removal returns next enemy turn.
BOSS_SEAL_INK_RETURN.brand: It returns as 2 Slippery and grants 1 Strength.
BOSS_SEAL_STARTLED_SHELL.title: Startled Shell
BOSS_SEAL_STARTLED_SHELL.summary: Wake-up source changes starting Plating and Soul Siphon relief.
BOSS_SEAL_STARTLED_SHELL.brand: Wake Plating rises to 10, and Soul Siphon only trims one-third.
BOSS_SEAL_SOUL_TIDE.title: Soul Tide
BOSS_SEAL_SOUL_TIDE.summary: Intangible entries and Beckon pressure grant Artifact and Block.
BOSS_SEAL_SOUL_TIDE.brand: Intangible grants 2 Artifact, and Beckon Block can reach 16.
BOSS_SEAL_BOILING_CRITICAL.title: Boiling Critical
BOSS_SEAL_BOILING_CRITICAL.summary: Steam Eruption milestones add stronger death-explosion pressure.
BOSS_SEAL_BOILING_CRITICAL.brand: Milestones trigger every 10 Steam, and warning Block is reduced.
BOSS_SEAL_MISALIGNED_SHELL.title: Misaligned Shell
BOSS_SEAL_MISALIGNED_SHELL.summary: Back attacks and claw deaths add capped shell protection.
BOSS_SEAL_MISALIGNED_SHELL.brand: Back-attack Block rises to 8, and the surviving claw gains 2 Artifact.
BOSS_SEAL_MARGINAL_NOTE.title: Marginal Note
BOSS_SEAL_MARGINAL_NOTE.summary: Curse of Knowledge adds a temporary note with end-turn pressure.
BOSS_SEAL_MARGINAL_NOTE.brand: Curse of Knowledge adds a second Marginal Note.
BOSS_SEAL_STRUGGLE_BAIT.title: Struggle Bait
BOSS_SEAL_STRUGGLE_BAIT.brand: Each unplayed generated Frantic Escape grants 5 Block after 2 player turns.
BOSS_SEAL_AEONGLASS_STRENGTH.title: Temporary Royal Seal
BOSS_SEAL_AEONGLASS_STRENGTH.brand: The second Boss version also starts with +5 Strength.
BOSS_SEAL_CHOSEN_DECREE.title: Chosen Decree
BOSS_SEAL_CHOSEN_DECREE.summary: One Bound card becomes a Royal Decree with capped Queen-side settlement.
BOSS_SEAL_CHOSEN_DECREE.brand: Missed decree grants the Queen 14 Block; obeying it grants players 5 Block.
BOSS_SEAL_RESIDUAL_SAMPLE.title: Residual Sample
BOSS_SEAL_RESIDUAL_SAMPLE.summary: Phase changes keep weakened samples from prior phases.
BOSS_SEAL_RESIDUAL_SAMPLE.brand: The first phase change keeps 2 weakened samples, then 1 afterward.
